newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-GOVERNMENT TO FOCUS ON BUDGET, SOCIAL AFFAIRS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-GOVERNMENT TO FOCUS ON BUDGET, SOCIAL AFFAIRS.

text.p: Prime minister Mart Siimann said on Wednesday the government would focus on 1998 state budget and on solving social affairs problems in the summer.
"We will search for solutions how to make the life of retired people easier in the next budget year," Siiman told a news conference.
Siimann added that the government would also like to include businessmen, scientists and representatives of different organisations in its discussions.
Also an initial project of pension reform, which was approved by the government in May, needs to be further discussed, he added.
The government is continuing its work on the 1998 state budget to present it to parliament in autumn, Siimann said.
As of now, the budget, worth 13.7 billion kroons, has not brought into balance, he added. According to the law, Estonia's state budget must be balanced.
